The previous asset was a 13.3238 by 82.1585 m rectangle with bounds [-284.6498,-271.3261] x [511.6723,593.8308], slightly north of the returned source shape; the revised walls follow the GIS polygon.

height_and_architecture.historical_description: Purdue Archives corporate record search-index text: 42 x 269 ft historic envelope; brick, stone, reinforced concrete; three stories plus basement; Tudor Gothic.
height_and_architecture.height_basis: The GIS Extrution field has undocumented units; 48 ft converted to 14.63 m is an explicit tentative interpretation, not a verified measurement.
uncertainties: Historic source says three stories plus basement whereas two GIS floor-count fields say five; the visible modeled level count follows the building-specific historic description.
No surveyed facade elevation, storey height, window schedule, entrance drawing, or roof plan was found.
Tudor-Gothic material/color, vertical window rhythm, stone bands, pilasters, pointed entrance, and dormer-like forms are schematic interpretations; general Cary images are not labeled CQE.
The orthophoto supports the footprint and a complex roof surface with interruptions, but does not resolve exact roof dormer geometry.
